reference_reuse: Exact prefix before macro_rules! precision_suite, except unused Original import removed; original recorded source copied unchanged beside harness.
reason_for_new_version: V2 remains immutable. V3 fixes the predeclared round-cap limitation and adds independently audited caller-owned frontend and ordered batch-CDF workloads, actual mixed-weight fixtures, exact wire bytes, and explicit release-package cache invalidation.

build.source_snapshot: Tracked and untracked production files from the isolated candidate worktree, including new modules and declared Cargo bench sources; SHA256 manifest before and after compile, and live source equality after compile.
build.cache: Fresh copyfile timestamps AND cargo clean --release --offline --package gr-tdigest before every build under the exclusive CPU lock. Retain clean log. Require build.log Compiling gr-tdigest with this exact snapshot path, retain and hash log.
build.binary: day-digest-probe-v3 copied into write-once evidence/v3/builds/<label>/probe and chmod 0555

timing.calibration: Baseline-only per-cell pilot; freeze ceil(60ms / baseline median ns per operation), with declared operation-specific initial minimum. Both arms use identical counts. No candidate-based tuning.
timing.repetition_escalation: One --rounds-scale 10 repeat allowed only when an existing complete matching scale1 run includes a sub-50ms retained batch. Reuse that original baseline calibration times ten, same patch/binaries/workload/settings/protocol. Preserve both results. Still-short batches remain inconclusive.
timing.improvement: All four adjacent AB/BA process-median ratios <=0.97. Must repeat on fresh held-out seed and all required unchanged-operation controls before retention.
timing.regression: All four paired ratios >1.03 rejects within the claimed scope. Do not hide regressing cells in a pooled mean.
timing.instability: Either arm max/min process medians >1.10 is inconclusive. Any retained batch below 50ms is inconclusive.
timing.scope: Single-thread native Rust only. No inference about default multithread deployment or Python/Polars/JNI overhead.
timing.generic_drops: Intermediate outputs are dropped within the timed loop, final output after timing. Exact post-batch checks outside clock.

frontend_owned.caller_reset: Preclone bounded pools of up to 64 Vec<FrontendDigest> inputs outside the timer; consume by into_iter. Final short group uses identical count in both arms.
frontend_owned.timed: Merge calls, output pushes to preallocated storage, input outer-pool container drop; no caller reset clones, no output drops or wire checks.
frontend_owned.exactness: Every produced output byte-compared with expected wire bytes outside the timer; audit also compares frontend output to baseline byte-for-byte.
frontend_owned.memory: Record conservative simultaneous input/output/container logical-byte estimate for 64 entries. This is not allocator capacity, peak RSS, or an exact allocation count.

scalar_cdf.synthetic_state: Alternating Mixed/Atomic kinds, non-unit and fractional mass, min below first Mixed centroid. Synthetic stored-state query tests do not claim empirical rank/value/CDF truth.
scalar_cdf.probes: Support extrema, raw type7 median, outside support, first/middle/last centroid exact hits, adjacent middle-centroid midpoint. All probe/output bits independently included in the audit state.

batch_cdf.nearlysorted: Swap final two finite probes, keeping infinity endpoints. Very small counts intentionally degenerate to unchanged order.
batch_cdf.nan: Every seventeenth probe is NaN, including the first.
batch_cdf.ties: Five empirical quantile values, sorted with duplicates.
batch_cdf.sparse_control: Atomic 1000-centroid fixture with as few as 1 or 8 probes exposes eligibility-scan overhead.
batch_cdf.exactness: Full query bits and full output bits in audit JSON, not hashes; compare baseline and candidate separately from digest-state fields. Timed calls check final batch output exactly against an untimed result and match audit state.

mandatory_targets.E20: All batch_cdf required shapes/counts in screen and confirmation; threshold and sparse controls cannot be omitted from a general batch-CDF claim.

exactness: Pure speed requires identical mean/weight/kind/stats/quantile/scalar-CDF/batch-CDF bits and exact wire bytes, no invariant failures, no hidden logical-storage increase. Every timed result must match its audited operation-specific route. Selected batch query/output bits must match independently of state.
quality: Report empirical quantile rank interval, type7 value error, p50/IQR, midpointCDF max, exact integer mass/count/extrema, finite/positive centroids, monotonic outputs and wire query/byte roundtrip. No hidden logical storage increase. Adversarial weighted E01/E06 reported separately. No blanket epsilon.
quality_defect_decision: ForE01/E06 baseline invariantviolationsareexplicitnegativecontrols. Repairedaffectedwork speed measuredhonestly; unchangedvalidordinarypathbit/qualitycontrols required. Materialrepaircostrequires explicittradeoffdecision, never comparingmissingwork asvalidcompetitor.
limits: This screening is not the complete release gate.
No original arithmetic is benchmarked as a proxy for modern baseline.
Same-config comparison is not matched-memory equivalence; all logical storage increases are explicit.
Confirm uses fresh seeds, not untouched-for-all-future-experiments holdout; changes selected after seeing confirm must use another registered seed.
No claim about PyO3/Polars/JNI overhead from native timing.
Global pass/fail is not aggregated to hide individual regressing cells.
A --limit run is diagnostic and cannot satisfy acceptance. Screen alone never retains a candidate.
Synthetic weighted stored states validate invariants and exactness only; no empirical-quality scores are claimed.
No sampling decisions or candidate edits after held-out evidence without a new independently registered holdout.
Compilation/smoke failure before any measurement may be repaired with an archived prior protocol; freeze all final file hashes again before comparing binaries.
